source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's direct rebuke and infancy image.
key_decisions.before: I, brothers and sisters, was not able to speak to you as to spiritual people, but as to fleshly, as to infants in Christ.
key_decisions.after: And I, brothers and sisters, could not speak to you as spiritual people but as fleshly people, as infants in Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I, brothers, was not able to speak to you as to spiritual people, but as to fleshly, as to infants in Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps all three repeated God possessives.
key_decisions.before: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building.
key_decisions.after: For we are God's coworkers; you are God's field, God's building.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves loss, salvation, and fire qualification.
key_decisions.before: if someone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, yet so as through fire.
key_decisions.after: If someone's work is burned up, that person will suffer loss, though personally will be saved—but only as through fire.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: if anyone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, yet so as through fire.

key_decisions.rationale: Makes the plural corporate referent clear.
key_decisions.before: Do you not realize that you are God’s temple and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?
key_decisions.after: Do you not know that you together are God's temple and that God's Spirit dwells among you?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Do you not know that you are God’s temple and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?

key_decisions.rationale: Retains reciprocal destruction and corporate holiness.
key_decisions.before: If someone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for the temple of God is holy, which you are.
key_decisions.after: If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy that person, for God's temple is holy—and you together are that temple.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for the temple of God is holy, which you are.

key_decisions.before: Let no one deceive himself. If someone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, let him become foolish so that he may become wise.
key_decisions.after: Let no one deceive oneself. If anyone among you thinks they are wise in this age, let that person become foolish so as to become wise.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you thinks that he is wise in this age, let him become foolish so that he may become wise.
